## Overview

This document explores the spatial structure of London's Santander Cycles network using historical journey records and docking station locations. Origin–destination relationships are represented geographically, enabling the calculation of straight-line distances and the classification of journeys according to their relationship with the River Thames. The resulting analysis identifies observed cross-river cycling patterns and establishes a comparative framework for subsequent network routing and connectivity analysis.


```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(sf)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(leaflet)
library(scales)
library(ggspatial)
library(ggrepel)

dir.create("outputs/web", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create("data/raw/map_tiles", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
```

```{r import-processed-data}
stations_sf <- readRDS("data/processed/stations_wgs84.rds")
stations_bng <- readRDS("data/processed/stations_bng.rds")
od_pairs <- readRDS("data/processed/od_pairs.rds")
thames_bng <- readRDS("data/processed/thames_bng.rds")

# Confirm spatial compatibility
stopifnot(
  st_crs(stations_bng) == st_crs(thames_bng)
)

# Inspect imported datasets
dim(stations_bng)
dim(od_pairs)
sum(od_pairs$journeys)
stopifnot(
  st_crs(stations_bng) == st_crs(27700),
  !anyNA(stations_bng$station_id),
  !anyDuplicated(stations_bng$station_id),
  all(st_is_valid(stations_bng)),
  all(!st_is_empty(stations_bng)),
  all(is.finite(od_pairs$journeys) & od_pairs$journeys > 0),
  !anyDuplicated(od_pairs[c("origin_id", "destination_id")])
)
journey_total <- sum(od_pairs$journeys)
```

```{r visual-identity}
col_station <- "#173F5F"
col_thames <- "#82B5D1"
col_cross <- "#D97706"
col_same <- "#64748B"
col_background <- "#F5F5F2"
```

```{r define-map-extent}
# Determine the spatial extent of docking stations
study_bbox <- st_bbox(stations_bng)

# Add a 1 km margin around the network
x_limits <- c(
  study_bbox["xmin"] - 1000,
  study_bbox["xmax"] + 1000
)

y_limits <- c(
  study_bbox["ymin"] - 1000,
  study_bbox["ymax"] + 1000
)
```

## Origin–Destination Spatial Analysis

Straight-line distances provide a geographical baseline against which modelled cycling routes can be compared. Docking stations are subsequently classified according to their position relative to the River Thames.


```{r calculate-direct-distances}
# Match origins and destinations to spatial station records
origin_index <- match(
  od_pairs$origin_id,
  stations_bng$station_id
)

destination_index <- match(
  od_pairs$destination_id,
  stations_bng$station_id
)

# Validate matching
stopifnot(
  !anyNA(origin_index),
  !anyNA(destination_index)
)

# Calculate pairwise distances in kilometres
od_pairs$direct_km <- as.numeric(
  st_distance(
    stations_bng[origin_index, ],
    stations_bng[destination_index, ],
    by_element = TRUE
  )
) / 1000

summary(od_pairs$direct_km)
```

```{r inspect-direct-distances}
ggplot(od_pairs, aes(x = direct_km)) +

  geom_histogram(
    binwidth = 0.25,
    fill = col_station,
    colour = "white"
  ) +

  labs(
    title = "Direct Distance Between Docking Stations",
    subtitle = "Unique origin-destination pairs | March 2026",
    x = "Straight-line distance (km)",
    y = "Number of OD pairs"
  ) +

  theme_minimal()
```

```{r create-bank-polygons}
# Construct rectangular study area
study_area <- st_as_sfc(
  st_bbox(
    c(
      xmin = as.numeric(x_limits[1]),
      ymin = as.numeric(y_limits[1]),
      xmax = as.numeric(x_limits[2]),
      ymax = as.numeric(y_limits[2])
    ),
    crs = st_crs(27700)
  )
)

# Combine and validate the river geometry
river <- st_union(
  st_make_valid(thames_bng)
)

# Subtract the Thames from the study area
land_geometry <- st_difference(
  study_area,
  river
)

# Separate disconnected land polygons
land_parts <- st_cast(
  st_collection_extract(land_geometry, "POLYGON"),
  "POLYGON"
)

banks <- st_sf(
  bank_id = seq_along(land_parts),
  geometry = land_parts
)

# Inspect polygon areas
banks$area_km2 <- as.numeric(st_area(banks)) / 1e6

banks
```

```{r inspect-bank-polygons}
ggplot() +

  geom_sf(
    data = banks,
    aes(fill = factor(bank_id)),
    colour = NA,
    alpha = 0.5
  ) +

  geom_sf(
    data = thames_bng,
    fill = col_thames,
    colour = NA
  ) +

  geom_sf(
    data = stations_bng,
    colour = col_station,
    size = 0.8
  ) +

  coord_sf(
    crs = st_crs(27700),
    xlim = as.numeric(x_limits),
    ylim = as.numeric(y_limits),
    expand = FALSE,
    datum = NA
  ) +

  labs(
    title = "River Bank Classification",
    fill = "Land polygon"
  ) +

  theme_void()
```

```{r assign-station-banks}
# Use interior reference locations on the northern/southern edges of the
# study rectangle, not the order returned by GEOS.
stopifnot(nrow(banks) == 2L, all(st_is_valid(banks)))
anchors <- st_as_sf(
  data.frame(bank = c("North", "South"),
             x = rep(mean(x_limits), 2),
             y = c(y_limits[2] - 100, y_limits[1] + 100)),
  coords = c("x", "y"), crs = 27700
)
anchor_matches <- st_within(anchors, banks)
stopifnot(all(lengths(anchor_matches) == 1L),
          length(unique(unlist(anchor_matches))) == 2L)
banks$bank <- NA_character_
banks$bank[unlist(anchor_matches)] <- anchors$bank

# Assign only unambiguous point-in-polygon matches.
bank_matches <- st_within(stations_bng, banks)
stations_bng$bank <- vapply(bank_matches, function(x) {
  if (length(x) == 1L) banks$bank[x] else NA_character_
}, character(1))

# Independent known-location sanity check using the station names.
# These named areas must be present and on their expected banks.
check_north <- trimws(stations_bng$station_name) == "Bonny Street, Camden Town"
check_south <- trimws(stations_bng$station_name) == "Waterloo Station 3, Waterloo"
stopifnot(any(check_north), any(check_south),
          all(stations_bng$bank[check_north] == "North", na.rm = FALSE),
          all(stations_bng$bank[check_south] == "South", na.rm = FALSE))

station_bank_summary <- stations_bng |>
  st_drop_geometry() |>
  mutate(bank = coalesce(bank, "Unclassified")) |>
  count(bank, name = "stations") |>
  mutate(station_share_pct = 100 * stations / sum(stations))
station_bank_summary
stations_bng |> filter(is.na(bank)) |> st_drop_geometry() |>
  select(station_id, station_name)
```

```{r classify-od-pairs}
# Extract station identifiers and bank classifications
station_banks <- stations_bng |>
  st_drop_geometry() |>
  select(station_id, bank)

# Attach origin and destination bank information
od_pairs <- od_pairs |>
  select(-any_of(c("origin_bank", "destination_bank", "relationship"))) |>

  left_join(
    station_banks |>
      rename(origin_id = station_id,
             origin_bank = bank),
    by = "origin_id"
  ) |>

  left_join(
    station_banks |>
      rename(destination_id = station_id,
             destination_bank = bank),
    by = "destination_id"
  ) |>

  mutate(
    relationship = case_when(
      is.na(origin_bank) |
        is.na(destination_bank) ~ "Unclassified",
      origin_bank == destination_bank ~ "Same-bank",
      TRUE ~ "Cross-river"
    )
  )

# Inspect classifications
count(od_pairs, relationship)
```

```{r summarise-cycling-flows}
flow_summary <- od_pairs |>
  group_by(relationship) |>
  summarise(
    unique_pairs = n(),
    total_journeys = sum(journeys),
    median_direct_km = median(direct_km),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    journey_share_pct = round(
      total_journeys / sum(total_journeys) * 100,
      2
    )
  )

flow_summary
stopifnot(sum(flow_summary$total_journeys) == journey_total)

# Four directional bank relationships; missing bank labels remain explicit.
bank_flow_summary <- od_pairs |>
  mutate(origin_bank = coalesce(origin_bank, "Unclassified"),
         destination_bank = coalesce(destination_bank, "Unclassified")) |>
  group_by(origin_bank, destination_bank) |>
  summarise(unique_pairs = n(), total_journeys = sum(journeys), .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(journey_share_pct = 100 * total_journeys / journey_total)
bank_flow_summary
```

```{r aggregate-cross-river-flows}
cross_flows <- od_pairs |>

  filter(relationship == "Cross-river") |>

  # Create consistent identifiers for both directions
  mutate(
    station_a = pmin(origin_id, destination_id),
    station_b = pmax(origin_id, destination_id)
  ) |>

  group_by(station_a, station_b) |>

  summarise(
    total_journeys = sum(journeys),
    direct_km = first(direct_km),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>

  arrange(desc(total_journeys), station_a, station_b)

# Inspect busiest cross-river connections
head(cross_flows, 10)

# Select the 40 busiest connections for mapping
top_flows <- cross_flows |>
  slice_head(n = 40)
```

## Cross-river journey concentration

Each journey contributes to both its origin and destination station. Station totals therefore measure endpoint activity, not distinct journeys across all stations.

```{r summarise-cross-river-hubs}
station_lookup <- stations_bng |> st_drop_geometry() |>
  select(station_id, station_name, bank)

# Rank all cross-river stations and the endpoints of the 40 displayed flows.
rank_hubs <- function(flows) {
  bind_rows(
    flows |> transmute(station_id = station_a, total_journeys),
    flows |> transmute(station_id = station_b, total_journeys)
  ) |>
    group_by(station_id) |>
    summarise(endpoint_journeys = sum(total_journeys),
              connections = n(), .groups = "drop") |>
    left_join(station_lookup, by = "station_id") |>
    arrange(desc(endpoint_journeys), station_id)
}
all_hubs <- rank_hubs(cross_flows)
mapped_hubs <- rank_hubs(top_flows)
stopifnot(sum(all_hubs$endpoint_journeys) == 2 * sum(cross_flows$total_journeys),
          sum(mapped_hubs$endpoint_journeys) == 2 * sum(top_flows$total_journeys))

# The three labels describe the mapped subset, not the entire network.
label_hubs <- mapped_hubs |> slice_head(n = 3)
label_hubs
head(all_hubs, 10)

flow_concentration <- data.frame(
  mapped_pairs = nrow(top_flows),
  total_cross_pairs = nrow(cross_flows),
  mapped_journeys = sum(top_flows$total_journeys),
  total_cross_journeys = sum(cross_flows$total_journeys),
  mapped_share_pct = 100 * sum(top_flows$total_journeys) /
    sum(cross_flows$total_journeys)
)
flow_concentration
```

```{r construct-desire-lines}
# Match station identifiers to spatial coordinates
a_index <- match(
  top_flows$station_a,
  stations_bng$station_id
)

b_index <- match(
  top_flows$station_b,
  stations_bng$station_id
)

stopifnot(
  !anyNA(a_index),
  !anyNA(b_index)
)

# Extract projected coordinates
coords_a <- st_coordinates(stations_bng[a_index, ])
coords_b <- st_coordinates(stations_bng[b_index, ])

# Construct one straight line per station pair
flow_geometry <- lapply(
  seq_len(nrow(top_flows)),
  function(i) {
    st_linestring(
      rbind(coords_a[i, ], coords_b[i, ])
    )
  }
)

# Convert to a spatial dataset
flows_sf <- st_sf(
  top_flows,
  geometry = st_sfc(
    flow_geometry,
    crs = 27700
  )
)

# Inspect the spatial object's properties
nrow(flows_sf)
st_crs(flows_sf)
table(st_geometry_type(flows_sf))
table(st_is_valid(flows_sf))

# Inspect the attribute table separately
head(as.data.frame(st_drop_geometry(flows_sf)))
```
```{r figure-2-cross-river-flows, fig.width=12, fig.height=8}
# Identify docking stations associated with the mapped flows
flow_stations <- stations_bng |>
  filter(
    station_id %in% c(

  )

# A local map extent includes every displayed endpoint, with 1 km padding.

flow_x <- as.numeric(flow_bbox[c("xmin", "xmax")]) + c(-1000, 1000)
flow_y <- as.numeric(flow_bbox[c("ymin", "ymax")]) + c(-1000, 1000)
label_points <- stations_bng[match(label_hubs$station_id, stations_bng$station_id), ]
label_xy <- st_coordinates(label_points)
label_data <- data.frame(x = label_xy[, 1], y = label_xy[, 2],
                         name = label_hubs$station_name)

fig2 <- ggplot() +

  # Muted OpenStreetMap basemap
  annotation_map_tile(
    type = "osm",
    zoomin = 0,
    alpha = 0.20,
    cachedir = "data/raw/map_tiles",
    progress = "none"
  ) +

  # River Thames
  geom_sf(
    data = thames_bng,
    fill = col_thames,
    colour = NA,
    alpha = 0.65
  ) +

  # Wider docking station network
  geom_sf(
    data = stations_bng,
    colour = col_station,
    size = 0.8,
    alpha = 0.20
  ) +

  # Cross-river desire lines
  geom_sf(
    data = flows_sf,
    aes(linewidth = total_journeys),
    colour = col_cross,
    alpha = 0.75
  ) +

  # Docking stations associated with mapped flows
  geom_sf(
    data = flow_stations,
    colour = col_station,

  ) +

  # Label the most active endpoints among the displayed flows.
  ggrepel::geom_label_repel(

    inherit.aes = FALSE, seed = 476, size = 3,
    colour = col_station, fill = "white", segment.colour = col_station,
    box.padding = 0.45, point.padding = 0.4, max.overlaps = Inf
  ) +

  scale_linewidth_continuous(
    name = "Recorded journeys",
    range = c(0, 2.5),
    limits = c(0, max(top_flows$total_journeys)),
    labels = scales::label_comma()
  ) +

  # Consistent geographical extent and projection
  coord_sf(
    crs = st_crs(27700),
    default_crs = st_crs(27700),
    xlim = flow_x,
    ylim = flow_y,
    expand = FALSE,
    datum = NA
  ) +

  # Scale bar
  annotation_scale(
    location = "bl",
    width_hint = 0.12,

  # North arrow

    pad_y = grid::unit(0.5, "cm"),
    height = grid::unit(1, "cm"),
    width = grid::unit(1, "cm"),
    style = north_arrow_orienteering(
      text_col = col_station,
      line_col = col_station,
      fill = c("white", col_station),
      text_size = 8
    )
  ) +

  labs(
    title = "Cycling Across the Thames",
    subtitle = paste0(
      nrow(top_flows),
      " busiest cross-river station pairs | March 2026"
    ),
    caption = paste0(

      "Basemap: © OpenStreetMap contributors\n",

    )
  ) +

  # Reuse Figure 1 styling
```
